referenceNote: Match only the rendering style of the attached QuinTaste game style board: soft rounded toy-like 3D, smooth clay-like materials, warm peach, cream, coral, honey-wood and sage colours, gentle warm light and the same character proportions. Do not copy any object, character or layout from the board.
base: Cosy mobile cooking-game art in the style of the reference image: a soft stylized 3D render with a hand-painted finish, chunky rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials with subtle glossy highlights, warm soft key light from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, warm saturated but natural colours and a crisp clean silhouette.

homeSkin.note: Café home skins ship in two sizes. Paint the portrait room first (it fixes the playable layout: hotspots, counter, decor spots), then widen it with widen.py and the 'widen' kind. The app shows the portrait room on phones and the wide room on tablets, desktops and landscape screens, with the portrait room pixel-exact in the middle.

kindBase.emblem: High-end mobile game UI art: a collectible achievement medal in a restrained, consistent style. Mostly polished champagne gold metal (about 85 percent of the medal) with crisp bevels and engraved lines, exactly one accent gemstone colour, and the subject shown as a simple bold gold relief sculpture rather than a coloured scene. Clean, readable silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels on a dark navy interface. Not busy, not cluttered, no extra gems or ribbons beyond those described, not cartoon clay, not blurry.
kindBase.giftitem: High-end mobile game UI art: one collectible gift item rendered crisp, clean and polished, with glossy specular highlights, a bright rim light and a sharp clean silhouette, limited calm colours, readable at 64 pixels on a dark navy interface. Just the item itself: no frame, badge, medal, border, pedestal, plate of light or background shapes. Not busy, not cartoon clay, not blurry.
kindBase.border: High-end mobile game UI art: a collectible avatar border rendered crisp, clean and polished, with glossy specular highlights, a bright rim light and a sharp silhouette, limited calm colours. The ring itself is slim; decoration sits mainly at the top and bottom so the photo inside stays the focus. Not busy, not cartoon clay, not blurry, no text.
kindBase.badge: High-end mobile game UI art: a premium achievement badge built in layers like a real 3D object: a back plate, a raised front plate, and wings, blades or ribbons around them, each layer with crisp bevels, polished metal, glossy specular highlights and a bright rim light. Every badge in the set shares this layered build but has its own distinct silhouette. The centrepiece is one bold symbol in a contrasting material (enamel or crystal) so it reads instantly at 64 pixels. A small, deliberate palette: the tier metal plus one or two accent colours. Not busy, not a flat coin, not cartoon clay, not blurry, no text.
